Name: Fish Tank Table
Author: DarkKassanova
Description:
This mod replaces either the Mahogany, Modern, Festive, or Winter dining tables with a Fish Tank! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/m7CSAEY.png[/img]

[b][u]To Install:
[/u][/b]1. Backup your furniture.xnb located at Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\TileSheets 
2. Download whichever dining table you'd like to replace with a fish tank
3. Replace your old furniture.xnb with the new one!

Downloads.Description: Download this file if you want to replace your mahogany dining table with the fish tank
